text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I attended a party for racing professionals
with Tokai Teio.
It was a formal event with a dress code, but—

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee
text_block_list.text:
"Your run in the Wakagoma Stakes was simply magnificent!
Please allow me to continue supporting you from now on."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I'll brace myself and work even harder so that
I can continue to contribute to the racing world!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Places like this really make me feel a little tense after all.
choice_data_list: You looked so dignified. Just what you'd expect from the young lady of a prestigious family.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi! Well, yeah. Gramps was always
scolding me about my manners and posture.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright then. At this rate, I'm gonna keep
putting my face out there before the Satsuki Sho~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hello!
Do you mind if I sit next to you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio spoke to an elderly gentleman standing in the corner of the venue.
In that instant, the entire room erupted into a buzz.

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, isn't the person she's talking to...
—A real heavyweight in the URA...!
—He's notoriously difficult to deal with, how can she just walk up and talk to him...?”
choice_data_list: (Are they really that big of a deal...?)
(Are they really that big of a deal...?)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
"...You, Umamusume over there.
I dislike people who pander around me."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then Grandpa,
why do you look so gloomy when it's a party?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... I'm only here because it's part of the job.
These kinds of parties are so stiff and formal, it's suffocating.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I totally get how you feel!
Strict manners really make you grind your teeth, right?"

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
Ho, you too?
Good grief, every single one of my joints aches...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that much!?
Uwaa... That sounds really tough.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! In that case,
how about I show you a great spot!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yukomaaa's such a lovely place♪
With such lovely waaters♪ Hyoi-ya! Soi-soi!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —...You know this song?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You can hear it at Yukoma Onsen!
Hot springs are the best! They're so relaxing,
and the food is delicious too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"We're revitalizing the town right now.
We've got more visitors and it's super lively!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"It'll be so much fun that even Grandpa's
wrinkly furrowed brow might completely vanish, you know~~?"

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text: Hoh... A furrow in your brow, is it?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
...Kukuku! Then how about we go smooth out
not just our feathers, but our wrinkles too~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi! You should definitely check it out!
I swear you won't regret it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, despite a few nail-biting moments,
the party came to a safe and successful close—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What?!
I'm the one who has to play host?!
choice_data_list: That's also for the Umamusume Racing International Summit...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes—do you remember that gentleman from the URA we chatted with at the party the other day?
He's the driving force behind this project.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Apparently, Yukoma Onsen Village was chosen as the summit venue on his recommendation. It seems visiting the hot spring town on your advice and taking a liking to it was a major reason.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And so, there have been recommendations from that gentleman to have you serve as the host for the summit attendees.
choice_data_list: You'd entrust Tokai Teio with such an important role...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This conference brings together competitors and racing officials from all over the world.
It is no exaggeration to say that the host will be the "face" that shapes the impression of the Japanese racing world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, you are approachable, well-versed in social etiquette,
and capable of adapting flexibly.
I believe you are the right person for the job, but what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm on it!!
Leave it to me, Prez!!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I heard from Madam President!
She wants me to drill the fundamentals of hospitality
into you until next year's summit, right?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I'm indebted to you for recommending our hot spring resort.
I'll teach you everything step by step♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, you two!
Don't hold back, give it all you've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tokai Teio was to undergo hospitality training
by working as a maid at the Yukoma Inn.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to live up
to Prez's expectations! Ei, ei, oooooh!
